EXIT=0, no errors. Now verify the full axioms output (no sorryAx), check the new `S1744ModelMapOfCoverMap` axiom footprint (it should use propext/choice/Quot.sound; note it depends on S1742/S1743 theorems whose axioms should be the same).

Then:
1. Rebuild olean into build dir.
2. Compute SHA256.
3. Check S1742/S1743 SHAs and olean timestamps for the report.
4. Write report file `coord/reports/S1744-category01-assembly-actual.md`.
5. Optionally append to AUDIT_LEDGER? The AGENTS.md says append facts to AUDIT_LEDGER.md. Given parallel writers, appending risks conflicts; the parent can do it. I'll mention in report. Actually, sibling packages (S1728) only wrote a report; the ledger has entries by root. I'll skip ledger.
6. Clean up probes.
7. Send message to parent with self-contained result.

Let me do the verification + hashes.

content.name: run_code
content.arguments:
{"code": "const res = await tools.pwsh({ description: "Verify axioms, rebuild olean, gather hashes", command: `$log = 'D:\\lean\\tmp\\s1744-final.log'
lake env lean tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1744Category01AssemblyActual.lean *> $log
Write-Output "COMPILE_EXIT=$LASTEXITCODE"
Write-Output ('errors: ' + (Select-String -Path $log -Pattern 'error' | Measure-Object).Count)
Write-Output ('sorryAx: ' + (Select-String -Path $log -Pattern 'sorryAx' | Measure-Object).Count)
Write-Output ('warnings: ' + (Select-String -Path $log -Pattern 'warning' | Measure-Object).Count)
Write-Output '--- axiom blocks for new constructions:'
Select-String -Path $log -Pattern 'S1744ModelMapOfCoverMap|S1744CanonicalModelHomActionActual|S1744RepresentableModelFunctoriality_holds|S1744SmallRawCoverDataRequired_of_bijective' -Context 0,3 | ForEach-Object { ($_.Line + ' ' + ($_.Context.PostContext -join ' ')) }
Write-Output '--- build olean:'
$out = 'D:\\lean\\.lake\\build\\lib\\lean\\tmp\\sheaf\\xif\\paper\\S1744Category01AssemblyActual.olean'
lake env lean -o $out tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1744Category01AssemblyActual.lean *> $log
Write-Output "OLEAN_EXIT=$LASTEXITCODE"
if (Test-Path $out) { Get-Item $out | Select-Object FullName,Length,LastWriteTime | Format-List }
Write-Output '--- sha256:'
(Get-FileHash 'D:\\lean\\tmp\\sheaf\\xif\\paper\\S1744Category01AssemblyActual.lean' -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
Write-Output '--- lines:'
(Get-Content 'D:\\lean\\tmp\\sheaf\\xif\\paper\\S1744Category01AssemblyActual.lean' | Measure-Object -Line).Lines
Write-Output '--- dependency hashes:'
(Get-FileHash 'D:\\lean\\tmp\\sheaf\\xif\\paper\\S1742TwoYonedaActual.lean' -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
(Get-FileHash 'D:\\lean\\tmp\\sheaf\\xif\\paper\\S1743CoverSliceActual.lean' -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
(Get-FileHash 'D:\\lean\\tmp\\sheaf\\xif\\paper\\S1733EssentiallySmallCoversActual.lean' -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
Write-Output '--- dependency olean times:'
Get-Item 'D:\\lean\\.lake\\build\\lib\\lean\\tmp\\sheaf\\xif\\paper\\S1742TwoYonedaActual.olean','D:\\lean\\.lake\\build\\lib\\lean\\tmp\\sheaf\\xif\\paper\\S1743CoverSliceActual.olean','D:\\lean\\.lake\\build\\lib\\lean\\tmp\\sheaf\\xif\\paper\\S1733EssentiallySmallCoversActual.olean' | Select-Object Name,Length,LastWriteTime | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 200`, workdir: "D:\\lean", timeoutMs: 900000 });
if (res.kind === "foreground") console.log(res.stdout.text);
else console.log(JSON.stringify(res));
", "description": "Final verification, olean build, hashes"}
